planets.name: Kepler-974 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-974 with a 0.177-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-974 c was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-974. Its orbit and size follow Rappaport et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
